body.name: WARP-rational one-sided response class
body.construction: \(\mathcal G^{\mathrm{WARP}}_3=\{g\in\mathfrak G_3: g(z)\subseteq z\ \forall z\in\mathcal B\text{ and }\exists\succ_g\text{ a strict total order with }g(z)=\max_{\succ_g}\{d\in\mathcal B:d\subseteq z\}\ \forall z\in\mathcal B\}\).
